server_states.cold_model_cache_miss: FastAPI process already serving; OCR worker stopped before the request (interpreter start + engine import + model load inside the request); all caches cleared
server_states.warm_model_cache_miss: FastAPI process and OCR worker with loaded models alive; OCR and parser caches cleared
server_states.cache_hit: same image bytes repeated; OCR result cache and parser cache populated; normalisation, region detection and reconciliation still execute

summary_basis: rows with sampler_running=false; the paired sampler_running=true rows feed only harness_sampler_ab and the memory profile
timing_boundary: HTTP POST /api/input/prepare (loopback, new connection, session cookie obtained before the clock starts) through complete JSON body; excludes student dwell, /api/analyze and browser rendering

host.isolation: SHARED_DEVELOPER_WORKSTATION_NOT_ISOLATED: other applications were running; figures describe this host under that load

sampler_overhead: the 25 ms process-tree sampler runs inside the FastAPI process; harness_sampler_ab compares the same workload with it paused and running
